explanationMd: By the quotient rule, log base five of x/5 is log base five of x minus log base five of five, or 3−1=2.

distractorRationale.a: A logarithm of a quotient is a difference, not a divided logarithm.
distractorRationale.d: This multiplies the logarithm by the base.
distractorRationale.c: Dividing the argument by five subtracts one rather than adding one.
